purpose: Teach: 冬季/転換期/引き揚げ/大出/炎上/踏み切っ/杏/撒き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 冬季、本気で、絶対、需要、絶対、当社、絶対、対応、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Winter demand is critical. I need you to handle it thoroughly and seriously.
lines.style: Direct, commanding opening. Clipped cadence on the key directives. Measured authority without hesitation. Eyes steady on Kenji. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、転換期、絶対、当社の戦略、絶対、見直しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The industry is at a turning point, and we're reviewing our strategy carefully.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'reviewing' to show active progress. Composed but attentive—meeting his authority with competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外事業、本気で、絶対、引き揚げ、絶対、慎重に、絶対、判断しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The overseas business pullout needs careful judgment. Don't rush it.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Pause after 'pullout' to let weight settle. Even tone, slightly slower. This is a critical decision—treat it as such.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前期、本気で、絶対、大出費、絶対、見直し、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're reviewing the previous period's major expenses and moving forward on it.
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Confident without overstatement. Slight nod of assurance in the delivery. Shows he's already on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: SNSの、本気で、絶対、炎上、絶対、リスク、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The SNS backlash risk is something we need to watch closely for the company.
lines.style: Measured but with underlying seriousness. Slight lean forward on 'watch closely.' This is a real threat—treat it with due respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規事業に、本気で、絶対、踏み切った、絶対、結果、絶対、当社、絶対、業績、絶対、伸びております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We took the leap on the new business, and it's showing results. Our performance is improving.
lines.style: Controlled pride in the delivery. Slight warmth on 'showing results.' Professional but with understated confidence. He's earned a moment of this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新商品、本気で、絶対、杏、絶対、フレーバー、絶対、展開しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The new apricot-flavored product line needs to roll out. Make it happen.
lines.style: Crisp, final direction. Sharp attack on 'apricot.' Quick pace. This is concrete, achievable, and expected to be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方の、本気で、絶対、種撒き、絶対、農家、絶対、当社、絶対、提携、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're partnering with local farmers on the groundwork for sourcing, and we're moving ahead with it.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment with quiet confidence. Steady, clear delivery. Shows the full picture—local sourcing, farmer partnerships, forward momentum. Closing note of competence.
